description: This file implements JSON decoding and registration for Wi-Fi configuration objects in a Linux platform. It includes functions to parse JSON files defining Wi-Fi related components, construct namespace hierarchies, register data models, and set callback functions for Wi-Fi, radio, access point, SSID, and default configurations.

methods.name: int set_bus_callbackfunc_pointers(char * full_namespace,he_bus_callback_table_t * cb_table)
methods.description: Sets callback function pointers based on the namespace prefix (Wi-Fi, radio, access point, SSID, default).

methods.name: int bus_register_namespace(he_bus_handle_t handle,char * full_namespace,he_bus_element_type_t element_type,he_bus_callback_table_t cb_table,data_model_prop_t data_model_value,int num_of_rows)
methods.description: Registers a namespace with the specified data model and callback table into the bus system.

methods.name: int get_int_type_from_str(char * int_str_type,he_bus_data_type_t * data_format)
methods.description: Converts string representation of integer types to enum data type.

methods.name: int decode_definition_str_type(char * str_value,char * data_str_type,he_bus_data_type_t * data_format)
methods.description: Decodes string value to data format enumeration.

methods.name: int get_data_model_prop(cJSON * wifi_def_obj,char * data_str_type,data_model_prop_t * data_model_value)
methods.description: Populates data model properties from JSON objects.

methods.name: int construct_namespace_and_register(he_bus_handle_t handle,cJSON * cfg_param,cJSON * wifi_def_obj,char * l_name_prefix)
methods.description: Constructs namespace paths and registers them based on JSON configuration, handling objects and arrays.

methods.name: void decode_wifi_object_recurse(he_bus_handle_t handle,cJSON * node,cJSON * wifi_def_obj,char * l_name_prefix)
methods.description: Recursively decodes Wi-Fi configuration JSON objects and registers namespaces.

methods.name: int decode_wifi_objects(he_bus_handle_t handle,cJSON * root_obj)
methods.description: Decodes the main Wi-Fi object definitions from JSON and initiates recursive processing.

methods.name: int decode_json_object(he_bus_handle_t handle,const char * json_name)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file, parses it, and initiates Wi-Fi object decoding.

ctags.name: bus_register_namespace
ctags.signature: (he_bus_handle_t handle,char * full_namespace,he_bus_element_type_t element_type,he_bus_callback_table_t cb_table,data_model_prop_t data_model_value,int num_of_rows)
